list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this bounty opened (2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written in our own words for this entry.
sources_note: Each trophy cites the official list (Exophase) plus a named guide (PowerPyx, PSNProfiles or GTABase), retrieved 2026-11-19. Where a location or step is not pinned down by a cited source, the guide says so honestly instead of inventing it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so treat the 7-stage roadmap in this dossier as the real plan: story first, then strands, collectibles, grind and cleanup.
steps: Follow the roadmap in order — stages 1–3 are the story, stages 4–7 are strands, collectibles, grind and cleanup.
Check the missable flags before each story chapter so nothing locks you out of a trophy.
The platinum pops the moment trophy 54 of 54 is earned; no extra task is needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; it is the first story trophy and cannot be earned again once the mission is passed, so play it through to its end.
steps: Start the story and play Chapter 1 until the mission Gone Fishing begins.
Follow the mission objectives to the end — do not abandon the mission mid-way.
The trophy pops when the mission completes. Point of return: the end of Gone Fishing itself.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1 to its end; the trophy is awarded for finishing the chapter, and it cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the story.
steps: Play each Chapter 1 mission in story order.
Finish any missable Chapter 1 mission trophies before the chapter closes.
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 1 mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2; chapter trophies are unmissable story progress, so keep playing the story and clear the chapter's missable mission trophies on the way.
steps: Play Chapter 2 missions in story order.
Clear the named-mission trophies of this chapter before moving on.
The trophy pops when the last Chapter 2 mission ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3; like the other chapter trophies it is awarded for story progress and cannot be missed while you play the story through.
steps: Play Chapter 3 missions in story order.
Clear the named-mission trophies of this chapter before moving on.
The trophy pops when the last Chapter 3 mission ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale; clear any remaining missable mission trophies here, because the story narrows after this point.
steps: Play Chapter 4 missions in story order.
Clear the named-mission trophies of this chapter before moving on.
The trophy pops when the last Chapter 4 mission ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission after Chapter 4; this gold trophy marks the end of the story, so make sure every missable story trophy is already earned before you start it.
steps: Finish Chapters 1–4 and clear all missable story trophies first.
Play the final mission through to its end.
The gold trophy pops when the final mission completes.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1; mission trophies only count while the mission is active, so finish it cleanly the first time through.
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1.
Play the mission through to its completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. Point of return: the end of Breakfast Run itself.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist; heist missions are one-shot story beats, so play it through to the end and do not quit out mid-mission.
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in the story.
Play the heist through to its completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. Point of return: the end of The Cartel Heist itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play; finish it in one clean run, because mission trophies only register while the mission itself is being played.
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story.
Play the mission through to its completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. Point of return: the end of Child's Play itself.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 3; play it through to the end in one go, as mission trophies only count during the mission itself.
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in Chapter 3.
Play the mission through to its completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. Point of return: the end of Headliners itself.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown; the airport takedown is a one-shot story mission, so finish it cleanly the first time it appears.
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story.
Play the mission through to its completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. Point of return: the end of VCIA Takedown itself.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4; it is one of the last named-mission trophies, so finish it before the final mission locks the story down.
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4.
Play the mission through to its completion screen.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. Point of return: the end of Operation Savage Glory itself.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats: finish the story, all strands, collectibles and activities, then mop up whatever the checklist still shows as missing.
steps: Finish the story and all character and stranger strands.
Complete every collectible set and activity the tracker lists.
Check the in-game 100% stats page; the gold trophy pops at exactly 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count — so grind them in free roam between missions rather than in one sitting.
steps: Stunts trigger on jumps, big air, near-misses, drifts and long wheelies.
Chain them in free roam: ramps, hills and traffic-heavy roads build the count fast.
Track the counter in this dossier; the silver trophy pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, challenges, stunts and partner activities — and the trophy pops after the last new type.
steps: Open the activities list and note which of the 9 types you have not tried.
Play one round of each untried type; winning is not required, trying is.
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges; replay any challenge until gold, using the weapon each challenge is built for, and treat the hardest few as a separate practice session.
steps: Visit a shooting range and work through the 42 challenges one by one.
Replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it scores gold.
The silver trophy pops when all 42 show gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida; learn each course's racing line, then clear the locations one by one and tick them off in the counter here.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location and fly the course once to learn it.
Win the race at that location; a win is what counts, not just finishing.
Repeat at all 14 locations; the trophy pops after the last win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so spread your wins across 20 distinct race events instead of replaying the same favourite.
steps: Pick a race event you have not won yet.
Win it; replays of an already-won race do not add to the count.
Repeat across 20 different races; the trophy pops at the twentieth win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge: take the fishing challenge against Cal, land the better catch, and retry it if he out-fishes you the first time.
steps: Find the fishing challenge against Cal.
Fish the challenge and aim for the bigger catch.
The trophy pops when you beat Cal; retry the challenge if you lose.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish — pick the shortest cabinet you find, learn its loop, and play it through to the end screen.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida.
Start a game and play it through to its end, not just a few rounds.
The trophy pops when the arcade game completes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission; character strands can close off as the story advances, so do Andy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them for the endgame.
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map.
Play through the strand to its final mission.
The trophy pops when Andy's final mission completes. Point of return: Andy's last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission; do his missions as they unlock, because character strands can close off once the story moves past them.
steps: Take Kenton's missions whenever they appear on the map.
Play through the strand to its final mission.
The trophy pops when Kenton's final mission completes. Point of return: Kenton's last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission; keep his missions current as the story advances, since character strands can become unavailable later.
steps: Take Billy's missions whenever they appear on the map.
Play through the strand to its final mission.
The trophy pops when Billy's final mission completes. Point of return: Billy's last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida: watch for the stranger markers on the map, finish each strand to its end, and use the counter here to track which ones are done.
steps: Explore the map and take stranger missions when their markers appear.
Finish each strand fully — a strand only counts when its last mission ends.
Repeat for 8 strands; the silver trophy pops at the eighth.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission; do his missions when they appear, because character strands can close off as the story advances.
steps: Take Randy's missions whenever they appear on the map.
Play through the strand to its final mission.
The trophy pops when Randy's final mission completes. Point of return: Randy's last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission; keep his missions current as the story advances, since character strands can become unavailable later.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear on the map.
Play through the strand to its final mission.
The trophy pops when Tyrone's final mission completes. Point of return: Tyrone's last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida; each spot is a scenic overlook, so work through them region by region and tick each one off in the counter here.
steps: Find a meditation spot — scenic overlooks across the state.
Meditate there until it registers.
Repeat at all 18 spots; the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for: take Bret's hunting strand, track the animal he names, and make the kill clean — this is a one-animal hunt, so do it when Bret's mission is active.
steps: Take Bret's hunting mission when it appears.
Track the unique animal Bret names and hunt it down.
The trophy pops when the hunt completes. Point of return: Bret's hunting mission.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets: cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them region by region and finish three complete sets — a set only counts when every card in it is found.
steps: Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them across Leonida.
Complete one full set, then a second and a third.
The silver trophy pops when the third set completes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida — the WAiNK spots are spread over the whole map, so clear them region by region and use the counter here to track your progress.
steps: Find a WAiNK It location and use the WAiNK interaction there.
Move to a new location; repeats at the same spot do not count.
Repeat at 100 locations; the silver trophy pops at the hundredth.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — shooting, driving, stunts and more all feed the same count — so keep chipping away at challenges in free roam and the trophy comes with normal play.
steps: Take on challenges as they appear in activities and free roam.
Complete 50 of them in total, any mix of types.
The trophy pops at the fiftieth completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape; do it while partner missions are available, and break line of sight until the stars clear.
steps: Bring your partner along in free roam.
Commit crimes until the wanted level hits 4 stars.
Escape the police and stay hidden until the stars clear — the trophy pops on escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your wanted level — keep the wanted stars alive between robberies and move fast from shop to shop.
steps: Bring your partner along and rob the first shop.
Move straight to a second shop, then a third, without losing the wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third robbery. Point of return: while partner free roam is available.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles: drive or enter new vehicle models as you find them around Leonida — variety matters, so seek out rare spawns instead of reusing the same cars.
steps: Enter or drive a vehicle model you have not discovered yet.
Hunt for new models in different areas — traffic, parking lots and events.
The trophy pops at the hundredth distinct vehicle.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus: trigger it in a fight with a crowd of enemies, and line up your shots while the focus window is active.
steps: Get into a firefight with at least 5 enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus ends — the trophy pops on the fifth.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport: get a plane off the ground without a scheduled flight — steal one from the tarmac and take off.
steps: Go to VCIA airport in free roam.
Get into a plane on the tarmac.
Take off — the trophy pops on the unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the military tank that shows up at high wanted levels — so build a big wanted level, survive the Rhinos, and do whatever the moment demands with them.
steps: Raise your wanted level until Rhino tanks respond.
Engage the Rhinos — survive the encounter.
The trophy pops once the Rhino moment is resolved.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm — one slip and the trophy fails, so retry clean.
steps: Find a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm.
Escape undetected; the trophy pops on a clean getaway.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — plan each vault, crack it, grab the cash and lose the police before the next one; the silver trophy pops after the fifth clean escape.
steps: Find and rob a bank vault, then escape the police.
Repeat at four more vaults — each escape counts.
The silver trophy pops after the fifth vault escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape: intercept one on the road, stop it, crack it open and lose the police before they box you in.
steps: Find an armored truck driving a route in Leonida.
Stop it and rob it.
Escape the police — the trophy pops on the getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida: drive, fly and walk the whole map until every named area is visited — the in-game map shows what is still grey.
steps: Open the map and look for areas you have not visited.
Travel through each unvisited area until it registers.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs: find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang until all nine are done.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang you have not hit yet.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs; the trophy pops after the ninth.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: head to a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy best done early in the story.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a beachfront bar spot with a view.
Order and enjoy a cocktail — the trophy pops on the moment.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side — the old-school GTA move, done on purpose.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get a car inside or at its doors.
Drive through the showroom and smash out through the glass.
The trophy pops on the smash-out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: follow through on your throws, finish the game, and the trophy pops at the end of it.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling and play it through.
The trophy pops when the game finishes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal: play the partner content, raise your standing with your partner, and keep at it until the partnership moment registers.
steps: Spend time on partner activities together.
Raise the partnership standing through shared activities.
The trophy pops when the partnership hits mass appeal.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500 — so choose actively whenever the game offers a decision instead of always picking the same safe option; the trophy comes from engaging with choices across the story.
steps: Take every choice the story offers you, in missions and in free roam.
Vary your choices instead of defaulting to one path.
The trophy pops once the tracked choice count is met.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the retry — the trophy rewards the comeback, so do not quit after a first failure.
steps: Attempt an activity or challenge and fail it once.
Retry the same thing immediately.
The trophy pops when the second attempt succeeds.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — a weird encounter out in the world — so keep exploring odd corners of the map and pay attention when something unexplainable happens.
steps: Explore unusual spots across Leonida — remote areas, odd landmarks, late-night corners.
Trigger a strange encounter when one appears.
The trophy pops when the strange event plays out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past a pedestrian slowly, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and bowl them over — a slow pass and good timing make it easy.
steps: Get a vehicle and equip a melee weapon.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian and swing as you pass.
The trophy pops when the melee drive-by knocks them over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts: collect marked bills from crime, hand them to your laundering contacts, and keep going until the total hits $250,000.
steps: Collect marked bills from robberies and crime.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops when $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida: buy clothes, weapons, food and gear as you play — big purchases like vehicles and property-adjacent goods speed it up.
steps: Shop normally as you play — clothes, weapons, food.
Make bigger purchases when you can afford them.
The trophy pops when total shop spending hits $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida: save up, buy each garage when it is offered, and the trophy pops when the eighth one is yours.
steps: Earn and save money from missions and crime.
Buy each garage property as you find it.
The trophy pops when all 8 garages are purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: open the app, register any vehicle you own or find, and repeat until ten are on the books.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register a vehicle to the app.
Repeat for 10 vehicles; the trophy pops at the tenth.
